long:
CISA KEV weekly digest, Nov 16–22, 2026: 9 newly confirmed exploited vulnerabilities.

Fix first:
• CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM, EPSS 78%
• CVE-2026-90817 — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap), EPSS 34%
• CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller, EPSS 5%
• CVE-2026-90436 — Apache Axis, EPSS 4%
• CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom VMware vCenter, EPSS 4%
…and 4 more.
